Skykomish–Stillaguamish–Sauk–Snoqualmie prospectivity — V0.3 (run coarse_v03_20260819T074445)
Relative rank, not a probability of finding gold. Scores max at 70/100 until terrain-trap scoring (Phase 2). Verify claims in BLM MLRS and current WDFW Gold & Fish rules before digging. In-water work windows apply (work windows differ per river — Skykomish mainstem/SF close after Aug 15).
Access overlays (drawn over the score color):
closed — state parks & water-supply lands
DNR trust land — closed without placer contract
wilderness — withdrawn, no-go
permission needed — WDFW / county / city
unknown — likely private, check county parcels
no overlay = likely open (non-designated National Forest, casual use)
■ red section = active mining claim (section-level)  ·  ● placer  ● lode (large = past producer)
Labeled dots = proposed sample sites (basin-band id, e.g. ST-H01): ● HIGH  ● MID  ● LOW
